name: mcp-handler
description: Hosts MCP servers inside Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Hono, and other Fetch-based JavaScript apps with one Web-standard request handler.

skills.name: Create MCP Handler
skills.description: Turns an MCP server definition with registered tools, prompts, and resources into a Web-standard Request-to-Response handler.

skills.name: Serve Both Protocol Eras
skills.description: Serves the 2026-07-28 MCP specification natively and falls back to stateless Streamable HTTP for 2025-era clients.

skills.name: Verify Bearer Tokens
skills.description: Verifies bearer tokens with withMcpAuth and answers 401 or 403 with RFC 9728 WWW-Authenticate challenges.

skills.name: Serve Resource Metadata
skills.description: Serves the RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata document that lists your MCP server's authorization servers.

skills.name: Trace MCP Messages
skills.description: Emits one OpenTelemetry span per MCP message, which Vercel's MCP observability reads to show server activity.
